description: Generate an image from a text prompt (1-1000 chars) and save it to the media library. aspect: 1:1 (default), 4:5, 9:16, 16:9 or 1.91:1. Returns id, url and mediaType; pass the url in mediaUrls of create_post / create_draft_post. Requires the MEDIA_WRITE scope. Limited by a monthly quota: HTTP 429 means it is spent, do not retry right away. 502 is a provider failure and can be retried; 503 with code FEATURE_DISABLED means AI images are not enabled on this deployment, never retry and use another media option; 422 means the prompt was rejected or storage quota is full.
name: generate_image
title: Generate image with AI
